comments.author: Tammer
comments.body:
There is a version crafted with a recipe from Xiu Ling, an npc who can appear at company colonies.

It is +1 Perfume Trading

It takes r12 handicrafts and is the same recipe as in the knickknacks book.

To recruit Xiu Ling to your colony, you do an immigration quest "Expensive Hobbies" from Calicut to deliver 20 Aloeswood to Anping. There is a possible followup immigration quest from Calicut to deliver 20 Frankincense to the company colony.

part of the memorial album Immigration Attraction (No.2).
